Retain branch: route-boundary tests prove no import from the production workbench, no product-state mutation or persistence, no external/network action, no inclusion in the default route or release claims, and deterministic fixture rendering | Reviewer signs the decision and exact diff. If removed, inspect the current ten-pane product with no dead entry point. If retained, inspect the labelled lab route separately at desktop/mobile and confirm it cannot be mistaken for or entered as a production workflow step | IR-075, IR-086; SC-01 design contract; release candidate not yet assembled |
